i.norm: Verifies that reading from a default-constructed channel (backed by a pre-allocated internal buffer) fully fills the destination ByteBuffer and returns the number of bytes read equal to the buffer's capacity. A default SeekableInMemoryByteChannel is initialised with IOUtils.DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE bytes (8 192), which exceeds the 832-byte destination buffer, so the read must satisfy the entire request: bytesRead == bufferCapacity and buffer.remaining() == 0.
Channel backed by the default internal buffer (8 192 bytes, all pre-allocated)
Destination buffer smaller than the channel's internal buffer
Read from position 0; the channel has enough data to fill the whole buffer
The buffer should be completely filled (no remaining space left)
The number of bytes transferred must equal the original buffer capacity
